rule: Within one workflow run, carrier records across attempts are mapped to the earliest observed job ID only when the same completed state, source, named assigned runner, job and complete nonempty per-step records including timestamps also match.
limits: The preserved original inventory holds all 5,394 distinct GitHub job IDs, including carried, skipped and unknown records.
Each confirmed group has one counted occupied interval. Untested matches, failed jobs and unknown intervals retain their original handling.
Fixed source, queue and lifecycle event rows are unchanged. Runner occupancy is distinct from billing, PR elapsed time and local author clocks.
Source classes, policy epochs and unknown intervals preclude a proven lifecycle tenth. Periodic, manual and open work retain their original scope.
